description: The image is a technical drawing titled "Diagram 11 Provision of permanent air vent openings in a solid floor". It is a plan, with the word "PLAN" written on the right side. A hatched wall runs along the top and the left side of the drawing, with a white rectangular area in the hatched corner. The top wall has an opening labeled "Airbrick" and the left wall has a second opening labeled "Airbrick". Dashed lines labeled "Duct" run from these two airbricks to a junction left of centre labeled "Mixing chamber". From this junction a dashed line runs to the right to a small rectangular grille with horizontal slats, labeled "Floor vent". To the right of the vent is a grey rectangle with the word "Fireplace" near its top and the word "Hearth" indicated by a leader line ending in a dot in its lower part. The un-hatched area is the floor, in which the ducts, mixing chamber, floor vent and hearth are shown. At the bottom of the diagram, a caption states: "Airbrick, duct and grille should have an equivalent free area of at least that recommended in Section 2, 3 or 4 as relevant".
